title: My Nephew Took My $132K Pension, Promised Me A Home For Life, Then Evicted Me. So I Let Him Wash
description: After I drained my $132K nursing pension to save my nephew from gambling debts, he notarized a promise for a lifelong home, sold the house, and evicted me. I found a voice memo of him admitting the con, sued for fraud, seized the property, and now run a boarding house where he washes windows in a vest that says 'Washed Out Trust'. Every lease includes his fraud docket as a warning. #RevengeStory #ProRevenge #Karma
thumb_text: I LET HIM WASH WINDOWS IN A WASHED OUT TRUST VEST
pinned_comment: If your nephew drained your entire $132,000 nursing pension and evicted you after promising a home for life, how would you respond? Share your story in the comments.
